name: atv-teaser-animation
_playback_note: Final video plays at 1.0x source speed (46s source -> 46s output). The earlier 0.5x slow-down (setpts=2.0*PTS) was reversed on 2026-05-22.

scripts.encode:mp4: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/%04d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -preset slow -crf 18 atv_teaser.mp4
scripts.encode:gif: ffmpeg -y -i frames/%04d.png -vf "fps=20,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen=stats_mode=full" palette.png && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/%04d.png -i palette.png -lavfi "fps=20,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5" atv_teaser.gif
scripts.build: npm run record && npm run encode:mp4 && npm run encode:gif
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run copy:assets
